name: Luoyang

queries.query: 洛阳市 自然资源 地籍图 地块 查询 GIS 不动产 登记
queries.scope: Find city-specific cadastral/registration evidence and an anonymous parcel-map service.
queries.result: The official Henan government-services entry identifies Luoyang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as the municipal body for 不动产查询; materials and conditions require an application. A municipal bureau budget also names construction of a Luoyang internet cadastral-map inquiry platform, but no public geometry endpoint was found.

queries.query: 洛阳市不动产登记资料查询 洛阳地籍图
queries.scope: Check city-specific registration-record access conditions and whether it publishes geometry.
queries.result: Official municipal service is available online/in person but requires an application and valid identity and, when applicable, proof of interest; this is record access rather than an anonymous full-polygon layer.

queries.query: Luoyang China public cadastral parcel GIS map service official natural resources
queries.scope: Cross-check English references for city-owned parcel layers or open map endpoints.
queries.result: Search results identified municipal registration procedures and a planned cadastral-map query platform, but no anonymous public polygon service.

portals.name: Luoyang 不动产查询
portals.operator: Luoyang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau through Henan Government Services
portals.observation: Municipal public-service procedure for registration-record inquiries; application materials/identity requirements apply. The procedure is not an anonymous parcel-vector API.

portals.name: Luoyang internet cadastral-map inquiry platform (budgeted)
portals.operator: Luoyang Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau / Luoyang Real Estate Registration Center
portals.observation: Official 2023 budget lists construction of an internet cadastral-map query platform; operational route and public access conditions were not found.

requests.observation: Official guide lists municipal bureau as implementing body, eligibility, required application and identity documents, and online/in-person modalities.
Official bureau budget identifies an internet cadastral-map inquiry platform project; no live public service link or polygon response was exposed.

freshResearch.observedCandidate: Municipal registration platform project is documented, but service path and anonymous polygon capability remain unverified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Luoyang municipal real-estate registration inquiry service and a city-funded internet cadastral-map inquiry platform project.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: City-specific registry service and planned platform are documented; no anonymous full-polygon geometry response or coverage is verified.

technicalBlocker: The identified municipal query requires application materials/identity, and the documented internet cadastral-map platform lacks a confirmed public endpoint. No public anonymous full polygon was retrieved.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the city platform is operational and what access, identity and geometry export routes it supports; no evidence establishes public vector access.
nextStep: Locate the actual Luoyang cadastral-map platform URL and published service/access terms; only then test a small anonymous feature query without submitting personal information.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
